name: Scrapeman Local API Client
free_limit: Free Apache-2.0 desktop API client for Windows, macOS and Linux with local Git-friendly collections, unlimited local history, HTTP/2, WebSocket and built-in request load testing; no subscription or account required.
watch_out: Runs on your own computer; no free hosted API infrastructure or Scrape.do proxy credits included. Optional Scrape.do proxy usage is separately billed. Response bodies are capped at 200 MB; installers may trigger OS unsigned-app warnings.
